Figure2: Overall architecture of AOP. The framework begins with the meta-agent performing a fast decomposition and allocation of the received user query, resulting in an initial plan. A detector is employed to improve the completeness and eliminate redundancy of the plan, while a reward model provides scores to guide the meta-agent in refining the plan further, which involves operations such as replan, plan-in-detail, etc. The refined plan is sent back to the multi-agent system for generating responses to the user query.
